review.note: Reviewed all 11 direct Python build/runtime/development requirements and the Node development requirement for 0.20.0, including candidates outside the declared bounds. All latest registry candidates satisfy the resulting requirements and advertise Python 3.14 support. Compared with the reviewed 0.19.0 receipt, only h2hdb advanced from 0.35.0 to 0.36.0 and hbrowser from 0.44.0 to 0.44.1; all other direct versions are unchanged. Reviewed core 0.36.0 schema6 source qualification changes and unchanged public download queue facade contracts. This release intentionally requires h2hdb>=0.36.0,<0.37.0 and removes the older schema5 compatibility lane; downloader never initializes or migrates databases. Reviewed hbrowser 0.44.1 upstream commit 68052ed2f7463392bcc5ed59f93bde35de8567f1 and README: the optional HBROWSER_CHROME_EXECUTABLE path skips automatic Chrome installation when configured while preserving the public browser API. The latest hbrowser remains within the existing >=0.44.0,<0.45.0 requirement. Installed the current core0.36.0 and hbrowser0.44.1 registry releases through the full dependency resolver; uv pip check passed for 43 installed packages. Nine focused tests passed, including actual schema6 SQLite administration and public queue coordination, active dependency metadata validation, rejection of the old core upper bound, missing dependency rejection, and inactive development-extra handling. The complete fast gate passed. The isolated installed-wheel smoke now validates its active runtime Requires-Dist entries against installed versions before accepting the three public exports, so --no-deps cannot conceal this conflict. This review does not replace the required full merge gate or claim live browser, account, network, MariaDB, or full multi-role Linux cohort verification. References: https://github.com/Kuan-Lun/hbrowser/commit/68052ed2f7463392bcc5ed59f93bde35de8567f1 ; https://pypi.org/project/h2hdb/0.36.0/ ; https://pypi.org/project/hbrowser/0.44.1/ .
